reason: I already pay an admin to put receipts into Excel, and if it's behind that's on her, not on a missing bot. I might let it read the free 40 out of curiosity, but I'm not adding another monthly subscription for something my staff already does.
objection: Duplicates and messy receipts are a people problem. A bot won't make my contractors send proper screenshots, and I'd still need someone to check what it writes into the sheet.
would_change_my_mind: If during the free trial it cleaned up our backlog from the group and caught real double payments my admin missed, so I could see it saves her hours every week.
